versions.name: Camp John H. Ware III

features.note: Every camper takes a swim classification test on arrival, and there is an early-morning Polar Bear dip.
A waterfront paddling area, open to campers who pass the swimmer test.
A BMX riding area plus a pedal-cart track.
A bouldering wall, taught with spotting technique.
A disc golf course, with an award segment for completing it.
An Art Academy area covering whittling and carpentry projects.
An Innovation area covering science, engineering, and design.
The Camp Ware Chapel, used for the inter-faith service.
Separate shower houses for adults, staff, and Scouts, plus pool-house showers.
Tent platforms with ramps are available on request.

versions.summary: Chester County Council Cub Scout overnight resident camp located at Horseshoe Scout Reservation in Peach Bottom, Pennsylvania.

sources.citation: coordinate geocoded from street address (US Census / OpenStreetMap), 2026-07-22

provenance.notes: Coordinate refined 2026-07-22 from the camp's street address (was a city/state-centroid approximation). Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/539-105490); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored website is an events-calendar venue listing with no property detail, so the council's own Camp Ware camp guide was used instead.
